whatIsOpenClaw.title: What is OpenClaw?
whatIsOpenClaw.paragraph1: OpenClaw is an open-source AI agent framework that goes beyond simple chatbots. Unlike cloud-based AI services like ChatGPT or Claude, OpenClaw runs locally on your machine and can actually take actions on your behalf — writing code, managing files, searching the web, controlling browsers, and connecting to platforms like Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
whatIsOpenClaw.paragraph2: Think of it as a personal AI assistant that doesn't just answer questions, but executes tasks. You describe what you want in plain language, and OpenClaw handles the technical implementation. It supports multiple AI models (Claude, GPT, Llama, etc.), has a rich ecosystem of 97+ community skills on ClawHub, and can be extended to fit virtually any workflow.
whatIsOpenClaw.paragraph3: Whether you're a developer looking to automate repetitive tasks, a researcher who needs to collect and analyze data, or someone with zero coding experience who wants to build a Telegram bot — OpenClaw provides the tools and flexibility to make it happen.
whatIsOpenClaw.highlight1Desc: 100% open source with 314k+ GitHub stars. Free to use with your own AI model API key.
whatIsOpenClaw.highlight2Desc: Your data stays on your machine. Full control over privacy and permissions.
whatIsOpenClaw.highlight3Desc: Extend capabilities with community-built skills from ClawHub marketplace.
